long_biography.plain_text:
A young sales agent when Armo opened its first foreign branch, Ruben Bontekoe took a stake in the Dutch venture in 1994. He owned 40 per cent, alongside the Italian manufacturer. Local warehouses brought its loading equipment closer to northern European customers, and the operation made a profit in its first year.

At N-Brands, the fashion company he helped build with Nikkie Plessen, Bontekoe faced another decision about expanding abroad. He wanted a strong partner who could accelerate international growth, while ruling out a complete sale. The pair sold a majority stake to Capital A in 2023. N-Brands combines its own shops and webstores with wholesale distribution and shop-in-shops, giving its collections several routes to customers.
long_biography.html:
A young sales agent when Armo opened its first foreign branch, Ruben Bontekoe took a stake in the Dutch venture in 1994. He owned 40 per cent, alongside the Italian manufacturer. Local warehouses brought its loading equipment closer to northern European customers, and the operation made a profit in its first year.

At N-Brands, the fashion company he helped build with Nikkie Plessen, Bontekoe faced another decision about expanding abroad. He wanted a strong partner who could accelerate international growth, while ruling out a complete sale. The pair sold a majority stake to Capital A in 2023. N-Brands combines its own shops and webstores with wholesale distribution and shop-in-shops, giving its collections several routes to customers.
